quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: A car suddenly cuts in front of you. What should you do first?

options.text: Honk your horn and brake hard.

questions.explanation: If a car cuts in front of you too close, release the gas pedal. This creates space between you and the other car without hard braking or swerving.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns you of danger ahead. Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of dangers in or near work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A divided highway is ending ahead.
A divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is starting ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When a curb is painted ____, it shows a loading zone or parking restriction.
questions.explanation: Painted curbs show parking rules. A yellow curb means there is a loading zone or another parking restriction.

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work right because one side of your car is higher.
You might damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
Your car might hydroplane if water is on the shoulder.
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: You reach a four-way stop at the same time as the driver on your left. Who has the right-of-way?
questions.explanation: When two cars arrive at a four-way stop at the same time, the car on the right has the right-of-way.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway angles toward the left. What does this mean?
questions.explanation: A solid line on the road edge marks the boundary between the road and shoulder. If this line angles toward the center, the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: Which is NOT a factor in how far it takes to stop your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on speed and road conditions.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If your car skids, do not brake. Braking can make the skid worse.

questions.question: You may not cross a single broken white or yellow line when:

options.text: You are turning left into a driveway.
The car in front of you is disabled.
You are passing to the right on a one-way street.

questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if you can do so safely and without interfering with traffic.

questions.question: To check your blind spot when changing lanes to the left, glance:
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot, glance over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.

questions.question: Which of these are used on some highways to direct drivers into the proper lanes for turning?

options.text: White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of the lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes
questions.explanation: Arrows show which lanes to use for driving straight or turning.

questions.question: Allow more space than usual when stopping:
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped on an uphill slope. If the vehicle ahead rolls backward when traffic moves, you will have room to avoid a collision.

questions.question: Oncoming vehicles are to your left and parked vehicles are to your right. You should steer:

options.text: Closer to the oncoming vehicles than the parked vehicles.
Closer to the parked vehicles than the oncoming vehicles.
Down the middle between the oncoming and parked vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Down the middle between the oncoming and parked vehicles.
questions.explanation: When oncoming vehicles are to your left and parked vehicles are to your right, steer down the middle between them.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where animals, people, and vehicles are likely to cross.

questions.question: When approaching a school bus stopped on the opposite side of a divided highway, drivers:

options.text: Must stop until the school bus starts moving.
Must stop until the stop arm is raised.
Must stop until the flashing lights turn off.

questions.explanation: When a school bus is stopped on the opposite side of a divided highway with flashing lights and a stop arm, you may continue driving. You must stop only if the highway has no divider between the lanes.

questions.question: You are crossing an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches with its siren and flashing lights. You should:

options.text: Stop immediately in the intersection until it passes.
Pull to the right of the intersection and stop.
Continue through the intersection, pull to the right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue through the intersection, pull to the right, and stop.
questions.explanation: If you are in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches with flashing lights or a siren, finish crossing and then drive to the right and stop. You must yield to all emergency vehicles using lights or sirens.

questions.question: If heavy smoke covers the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Turn on your four-way flashers and continue.
Slow down, move right as far as possible, and stop off the road.
Turn on your high beam headlights and continue.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move right as far as possible, and stop off the road.
questions.explanation: If you see heavy smoke on the road ahead, slow down right away, drive as far as possible to the right, and stop off the roadway. Then decide if it is safe to continue. Some smoke can harm your eyes, lungs, or health.

questions.question: Round signs indicate:
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers of an upcoming railroad crossing. Use extra caution when approaching railroad crossings.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, what should you do with your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: When parking on a downhill slope, turn your wheels toward the curb. If your vehicle rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: You must give the right-of-way to pedestrians who are:
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians crossing any street. This includes marked crosswalks, unmarked crosswalks, and intersections. Always put safety first.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a reversible lane control signal mean?

options.text: The signal is about to change to a red X.
Drivers should not drive in this lane.
Drivers may use this lane only to turn left.
Drivers may drive normally in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may drive normally in this lane.
questions.explanation: Lane control signals show which lanes are open or closed. A green arrow means you can drive normally in that lane. A red X means the lane is closed.

questions.question: When should you increase the distance between your vehicle and the vehicle ahead?

options.text: When following a small passenger vehicle.
When another driver is tailgating you.
When you are driving slower than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: When another driver is tailgating you.
questions.explanation: When being tailgated, increase the space in front of your vehicle. Slow down gradually or change lanes. Do not brake suddenly, as this can cause a crash.

questions.question: When should you slow down when using a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: After you move onto the exit ramp.
You should keep your speed the same.
While passing slower traffic on the ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Stay at freeway speed until you enter the exit ramp. Then slow down on the ramp itself.
